connector.name: Brilliant Directories MCP
connector.registryDescription: Official MCP server for Brilliant Directories - manage members, posts, leads, reviews, and more.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package brilliant-directories-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the brilliantdirectories account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: BD_API_KEY
env.description: Your Brilliant Directories API key. Generate one in BD Admin → Developer Hub → Generate API Key.

env.name: BD_SITE_URL
env.description: Your BD site URL, e.g. https://yoursite.com (BD_API_URL is also accepted as a legacy alias).
